EmailTemplate.name: Under 90K Turn Down Email
EmailTemplate.subject: Thank you for your interest in National Funding.
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Dear valued business owner,
Upon further review of your information, our records indicate that your annual gross sales are below the minimum needed to proceed at this time. (Minimum required: $250,000 annually).
If our information is incorrect, please reapply at nationalfunding.com and we will get back to you as soon as possible.
We invite you to take advantage of our small business resource center which is updated regularly with a variety of information and materials to support business owners and help them grow. In addition, we'll occasionally send you articles that may be of interest.
We are sorry we can't work with you today, but look forward to serving you in the future.
Your Small Business Support Team National Funding ________________________________________________________
National Funding respects your privacy. Our commitment to your privacy is described in our privacy policy, which is available on our website for your reference.
Click unsubscribe if you no longer wish to receive emails from us. You may also unsubscribe by sending written notice to: National Funding Unsubscribe, {!$Setup.Company_Information__c.Street__c}, {!$Setup.Company_Information__c.City__c}, {!$Setup.Company_Information__c.State__c} {!$Setup.Company_Information__c.Zip__c}.
